calls.prompt:
Create a TWO-FRAME transparent PNG sprite strip based on the attached original right-facing Slayer sprite sheet. This is a smaller, clean two-pose asset: exactly two equal square cells side-by-side, one complete fighter in each cell, in this order: preparation, active downward sword swing. Request a 1280 x 640 canvas with two 640 x 640 cells; if the image tool uses a different output size, preserve two equal square cells and keep the complete silhouettes inside them.

Preserve the original character design and proportions: same black-haired male, black/gunmetal armor with red glowing cracks, red accents, torn black-red cape, heavy boots, and the same oversized jagged black-steel greatsword with a red core. The sword-to-body size ratio must match the original. Do not enlarge, shrink, stretch, or otherwise resize the sword independently of the complete fighter.

LAYOUT AND MARGINS: leave at least 80 pixels of fully transparent padding between each silhouette and every edge of its own square cell, including the center seam. There must be a clearly visible transparent vertical gutter at the center between the two cells: at least 80 empty pixels on the right side of cell one and at least 80 empty pixels on the left side of cell two. No pixel of hair, cape, hand, sword, glow, or antialiasing may enter that gutter. Leave at least 80 pixels of transparent outer padding around each silhouette. Use a compact side-view pose and angle the sword steeply enough to fit the identical complete blade inside its cell. Keep the full hair, cape, boots, hilt, and sword tip visible. No text, borders, labels, floor, scenery, shadows, or extra effects.

Both frames face screen-right from the same fixed side-view camera. Keep the boots planted at identical positions on one shared baseline. Keep the head, shoulders, torso height, leg spacing, and full-body scale identical. The body must not crouch, sit, jump, or rise. Animate only shoulder and arm movement and rotate the sword in the hands.

Frame 1: upright planted preparation guard, sword held diagonally up and back near shoulder height. Frame 2: a clearly active downward sword slash, arms swung and the same sword rotated diagonally down and forward toward screen-right. This is the beginning of one grounded attack. Keep the torso mostly steady.

WEAPON RIGIDITY: the exact same one-piece sword in both frames, with identical apparent overall length, width, thickness, serrations, hilt, red core, and perspective. Only rotate it around the grip. Never bend, warp, foreshorten, stretch, duplicate, change perspective, or alter the blade proportions. Preserve the sharp, detailed fantasy-game illustration style and transparent alpha background.
